panel-001.alt: NEVER AGAIN, AUSTRALIA cover featuring HOGIRL.

captions.text: NEVER AGAIN, AUSTRALIA

panel-002.alt: An English-test result and HOGIRL's hands.

captions.text: First hurdle, cleared.
ENGLISH. ✓

panel-003.alt: Letters of recommendation from Korean chefs.

captions.text: I received letters of recommendation from some of Korea’s top chefs.

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL reacts to acceptance at Le Cordon Bleu Paris.

captions.text: ACCEPTED. Finally— Le Cordon Bleu Paris.

panel-005.alt: A surprised HOGIRL looks at a calendar with six months remaining.

captions.text: SIX MONTHS?!

panel-006.alt: A tattoo artist and HOGIRL's ROOPRETELCHAM tattoo.

captions.text: ROOPRETELCHAM. A spell for making things happen.

panel-007.alt: HOGIRL considers how to use the six months before school.

captions.text: I’m not wasting six months. How should I use that time?
If I could teach in English, I could teach chocolate anywhere.

panel-009.alt: HOGIRL arrives in Melbourne with luggage near a tram.

captions.text: So I went to Melbourne for my TESOL.
I got my TESOL certificate.

panel-011.alt: HOGIRL explores the Great Ocean Road on a weekend.

captions.text: On weekends, I explored Australia.
GREAT OCEAN ROAD.

panel-012.alt: HOGIRL looks over the Twelve Apostles coastline.

captions.text: It was beautiful.

panel-013.alt: A triptych recalls old European alleys, buildings, and paintings.

captions.text: In Europe, even an old alley, a building, or a painting could make my heart flutter.

panel-014.alt: A small HOGIRL faces the vast Australian sea and sky.

captions.text: Australia was just— BIG. The sky. The sea. The land. And I felt tiny in front of it all.

panel-015.alt: HOGIRL stands at an Australian coastline.

captions.text: Australia wasn’t the problem.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL looks toward the sea in a reflective triptych.

captions.text: Even somewhere this beautiful, I still couldn’t simply enjoy it. I didn’t know that then.

panel-017.alt: HOGIRL visits Phillip Island in cold weather.

captions.text: I came to Phillip Island to see the penguins.
I’m freezing!

panel-018.alt: Seagulls stare at HOGIRL and her chips.

captions.text: Wait. Why are they looking at me? …Oh. The chips?
Then—
WHOOSH!!!
MY CHIPS!!!

panel-020.alt: HOGIRL runs from seagulls while holding fries.

captions.text: AAAAAAH!!!
OH, COME ON!!! I HATE IT HERE!!!

panel-021.alt: A serious HOGIRL with a clean shoulder after the seagull attack.

captions.text: I’m serious. I’m never coming back here.

panel-022.alt: HOGIRL appears small against the ending horizon.

captions.text: Life didn’t take me very seriously.
